body: [CVPR 2024 Oral] InternVL Family: A Pioneering Open-Source Alternative to GPT-4o.  接近GPT-4o表现的开源多模态对话模型
plain_description: **Analyze images and video with open source multimodal models.** Use the models for visual question answering, image and video understanding, and image text retrieval. Local chat demos and fine tuning are documented.
technical_description: InternVL is an open source family of multimodal models for visual perception, image text retrieval, and image and video chat. The repository provides model checkpoints, inference examples, training and fine tuning code, evaluation tools, and a Streamlit chat demo. Models are used through Python and Hugging Face Transformers; the README shows CUDA execution and multi GPU loading.
title: InternVL Family
